CustomField.label: Child Field
CustomField.description: For a child total column: the field of the child table's object to total, by API name, such as Amount. Sum and Average take a number, currency or percent field; Min and Max also a date or date/time. Leave blank with Count to count the records.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For a child total column: the child records' field to total, such as Amount. Blank with Count counts the records.
